job_description_info.job_description:
# Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity

**Company:** Corvale Mobility (fictional name; intercity rail and coach operator)
**Location:** Kraków, Poland (contract, remote-friendly; occasional office days)
**Engagement:** Service agreement (B2B / freelance), not an employment contract
**Rate:** 95 – 125 PLN per hour

## The engagement

Corvale is preparing a new generation of trains and needs a cloud infrastructure engineer for the team that links the vehicles to the company's cloud platform. You will help shape the architecture from the start and take it to production.

## Scope

- Design, build and operate the cloud infrastructure that links on-board train systems with backend services: telemetry ingestion, alerting, video streaming and remote content updates
- Maintain the infrastructure-as-code repository (Terraform with Terragrunt), keeping it tidy and approachable
- Lead technical proposals across backend and infrastructure from idea to production
- Contribute to system design and challenge decisions with arguments
- Set up secure train-to-cloud communication (mutual TLS, certificate management, network design)
- Agree interfaces and responsibilities with train manufacturers' engineers
- Support backend developers in deploying services that are easy to monitor and run
- Keep the platform observable, reliable and secure

## Requirements

- Hands-on infrastructure engineering and cloud environment design and operation
- AWS preferred; other major clouds acceptable
- Strong Terraform and Terragrunt
- Good understanding of systems architecture and system design
- Networking knowledge, including mTLS and SSL/TLS
- Practical security awareness
- Experience leading technical topics and bringing stakeholders along
- Strong analytical thinking and clear communication

**Nice to have:** IoT or automotive/remote-device integration, backend or full-stack background (JVM preferred), Linux and virtual machines.

## Working model

Independent contractor, invoicing monthly for agreed services.

company_info.company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held, founder-led transportation and technology company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It operates long-distance bus services and a growing passenger-rail network in Central Europe. Regional partners operate many routes, while Corvale manages the brand, network planning and digital platform for booking, trip tracking and travel extras. The company is investing in a new train fleet and expanding its use of data and machine learning.

Engineering-led and technology-first, Corvale gives teams end-to-end ownership of their systems. Its stated values are **“Lead, Shape, Own, Enjoy the journey,”** with an emphasis on collaboration, shared goals, sustainability and individual career ownership. Employees describe the culture as collaborative, fast-moving and open to new ideas.

The company has received workplace culture awards covering innovation, flexibility, purpose and values, professional development and employee appreciation. It has international teams, technology offices in Kraków and other Central European cities, and operations offices across its network. Employees can work hybrid and receive travel benefits; many technology roles are also open to independent contractors.

The 60-server VMware-to-Azure migration supports this wording more directly than a broad claim of technical leadership.
4. In the third paragraph, make the security evidence more concrete by changing 'practical security awareness' to 'practical security experience, including MFA, conditional access, backups, Azure Firewall, and private endpoints.' Each of these items is supported by the CV and this wording improves ATS relevance without adding unsupported mTLS or SSL/TLS claims.
5. In the closing paragraph, replace the generic 'infrastructure and automation experience' wording with the role-relevant capabilities actually demonstrated. For example: 'I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience with Azure infrastructure operations, Terraform-based networking, virtual machines, AKS, and deployment automation could support Corvale’s fleet-connectivity project.'
6. Add one brief, truthful culture connection before the closing, such as: 'Corvale’s engineering-led model, in which teams shape and own their systems end to end, is especially appealing to me.' This uses the company information and makes the letter warmer and more personal without claiming prior knowledge of Corvale or unsupported cultural experience.

MINOR PRESENTATION IMPROVEMENT
7. In the salutation, use a named hiring manager only if the candidate has a verified name; otherwise retain 'Dear Hiring Manager,' because it is professional and avoids inventing a contact.
